claude.result:
Perfect! I found the real issue—there were **three** places with the bug:

1. `src/money.js` - `parseEuros()` (handles decimal point format like 39.95)
2. `src/money.js` - `cellCents()` (handles spreadsheet imports)
3. `src/locale.js` - `decimalCommaToCents()` (handles European decimal comma format)

All three were doing `* 100` without `Math.round()`, causing the floating-point precision error. They're now all fixed. Test it with 39.95 now—it should work!
step_results:
Perfect! Fixed. The problem was floating-point precision when converting prices to cents. Using `Math.round()` ensures prices like 39.95 convert to exactly 3995 cents instead of 3995.0000000000005.

The fix handles both `parseEuros()` (used by the `add` and `price` commands) and `cellCents()` (used by `import`). Your gym membership and any other decimals should now work fine.
